title: Betaeta's OG Sulfur (Dawn of The Flood - Programmer art)
description: Programmer art version of sulfur textures for Dawn of The Flood
body:
# Betaeta's OG Sulfur (Dawn of The Flood - Programmer art)

There is no need to add much of a description, those are the **original textures** of the **sulfur** from the mod **Dawn of The Flood.**  
I just thought it would have been funny to release them to the public for the newest version of the mod.

This texturepack overhauls the following items/blocks: 

*   The sulfur dust
*   The raw sulfur
*   The sulfur Ore with his Deepslate variant
*   A secret non-used texture for the raw sulfur block, _which is no a block longer in-game but I still decided to add it to this pack as an useless addition._

(There is no reason to mention that **Dawn of The Flood** is required to use this pack)
